notes.title: Ninja Issen 1.30 patch update + Nintendo Switch™ version released! 02/20/2025
notes.notes:
Hello from the team at CFK.

Thank you so much for all of the interest and affection you've shown to hyper ninja action game Ninja Issen.

Today (Feb 20th), alongside the release of version 1.30 of Ninja Issen to Steam, we would like to announce the good news regarding the official release of the Nintendo Switch version of the game!

First of all, let's use today to share the details of the version 1.30 patch for Steam.

▶ Steam Cloud support
For UMPC players, including those using the Steam Deck, patch 1.30 will allow saves to the Steam Cloud starting today.

Now, you can continue where you left off in Ninja Issen no matter where you are. Go back and forth from PC and the Steam Deck to join Kiba's journey for revenge!

▶ Improved overall gameplay experience
• The basic framerate of the game has been slightly improved. Enjoy the smoother, quicker action!
• Based on player feedback, the level designs of some stages have been improved to be more intuitive.
• The camera movements have been improved to make it easier to understand terrain and player situation.

▶ Other fixes
• Bug fixes and other quality-of-life improvements have been implemented.

The Nintendo Switch™ version of Ninja Issen will be releasing to the globe today under the name Ninja Issen: The Scroll of Dimension, including all of the improvements besides the Steam Cloud features, so that players can enjoy a smooth gaming experience.

Enjoy this hyper ninja action game, now on the Nintendo Switch™ as well!

▼ Official trailer for the Nintendo Switch™ release of Ninja Issen: The Scroll of Dimension

[previewyoutube=wGaFVrXzIjI;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, thank you so much for your continued support as we at CFK strive to become the best publishing company we can be.

Best wishes,
The team at CFK

notes.title: Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) 1.09 patch notes (Jan 18, 2024)
notes.notes:
Hello from the team at CFK.

Thank you for all of the love and attention you've paid to hyper ninja action game Ninja Issen.

In order to create a richer, smoother gaming experience for players, patch 1.09 will be released today (1/18) with the following changes:


• Hardcore mode added.
 - This is a new challenge mode that can be enjoyed after clearing the game and starting a new game.
 - Dash through the entire game, from chapters 1 to 9, racking up both the highest score and the fastest cleartime!
 - Enemy attacks have become much more dangerous, and a single death means permanent game over.
 - In this mode, dialogue and game events do not appear.


• Control explanation 'Tips' have been added.
 - These tips will allow players to better understand the game controls.
 - Upon acquiring a new skill, players will be able to better understand the specifics of that skill.
 - Players may now check important tips on some screens.


• Fixed many bugs and added various quality-of-life improvements.

We hope you'll experience this smoother version of Ninja Issen for yourself, and thank you to all of the people who have played Ninja Issen and visited our community page.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

notes.title: Information on the official release of Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is CFK.

Thank you for the outpouring of love and attention you’ve shown for hyper ninja action game Ninja Issen (忍者一閃).

Today (Nov. 23), Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) is finally available around the globe on the Steam store!
This release is all thanks to the player interest and feedback we received during the demo release and our participation in Steam Next Fest, turning this project into a joint development effort.
Let us take this opportunity to give a special thanks to all the gamers who have waited all this time.

Download Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) now on Steam, and experience the hyper ninja action that sends you reeling between the past and the present!

《 Steam 「Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)」 Official Launch Trailer 》
[previewyoutube=pE9xVPLFY_E;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of everything, it's thanks to the support of our players that Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) reached the number 2 spot among Popular Upcoming games on Steam, and number 1 in the action genre.
Let us extend our utmost gratitude once more as we pledge to repay the love and support you've shown us with even more stupendous games in the future that will live up to all the hype.

We are also selling the Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) original soundtrack along with the game, complete with its intense beat and retro feel, so don't miss your chance of picking it up as a bundle!

《 Ninja Issen (忍者一閃) official homepage 》
▸ https://www.cfk.kr/ninjaissen/en/


We're always so thankful for the outpouring of support as we at CFK continue to strive to be the best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

We hope that you will try out the new and improved demo for Ninja Issen. We will be in touch soon with news about its official release.
